findings.title: Factionless dweller PawnKindDefs have no backstoryFilters: generating one logs a red error
findings.detail: TUBAD_DwellerBase (Defs/TUBAD_Creatures.xml) declares neither backstoryFilters nor backstoryFiltersOverride. DungeonCreatureGen.Make generates humanlike packs with faction null, so the faction can't supply categories either. GetBackstoryCategoryFiltersFor then hits Log.ErrorOnce("PawnKind ... no backstoryCategories in either") the first time a humanlike pack wakes each session, and falls back to FallbackCategoryGroup. Add a <backstoryFilters> block to TUBAD_DwellerBase, as vanilla's factionless WildMan does (e.g. Offworld/Pirate/Tribal).

findings.title: Hediff_DungeonMad.Ensure starts its state with transitionSilently: true, which skips RecoverFromState on whatever state it replaces
findings.detail: TryStartMentalState only calls curStateInt.RecoverFromState() when transitionSilently is false. So if a mad creature is ever in another mental state (a psycast, another mod's state, a manhunter state left over from the hunt mechanic), Ensure overwrites it without running its PostEnd. It is harmless for the base-game states these creatures normally get. Passing transitionSilently: false would only add the TimesInMentalState record and the letter check, and ShouldSendNotificationAbout stays false for factionless wild pawns. Leaving it as it is is defensible.

findings.title: Wake marks a pack woken before Make, so a pack that throws while being made is lost for good
findings.detail: MapComponent_DungeonCreatures.Wake sets pack.woken = true and then calls DungeonCreatureGen.Make inside a try. On an exception it logs once and returns, and the chamber stays empty for the life of the map. That is better than an error every 60 ticks and is probably what was intended. If a Titan roll or a modded PawnKindDef fails in testing, it will show up as one '[Dungeons] Could not make pack' line, not as repeated errors.

findings.title: The four new patch targets are not in the Schematic
findings.detail: verify_patches reports GenAI.CanBeCaptured, CaravanUtility.ShouldAutoCapture, TameUtility.CanTame and MentalState_Manhunter.ForceHostileTo as 'Not in the Schematic: update_schematic if these are meant to stay.' This is bookkeeping and does not affect binding.

findings.title: Ensure() swaps mental states silently, skipping the old state's RecoverFromState
findings.detail: DungeonMadness.cs (outside this reviewer's file list) calls TryStartMentalState with transitionSilently: true. When the pawn is already in another state, the handler skips curStateInt.RecoverFromState() and overwrites it. That is harmless for the states a freshly woken pack can be in. Pass transitionSilently: false only if a state with cleanup could be replaced.
